estimand: For each optimizer update, sum clipped GRPO token losses over both dispatched ranks and all microbatches in that update, divide by the active-token total, then apply a deterministic SGD step. Compare loss, DDP-synchronized gradient, and final parameters to an independent token-local pooled oracle.

fixture.model: Deterministic two-token token-local model; same initialization in both ranks and both arms.
fixture.optimizer: SGD, no weight decay, no gradient clipping.
fixture.token_mask: Only completion positions count; prompt, context, and padding positions are masked.

hypothesis: The pinned base misweights the two-microbatch first update; the PR candidate matches the pooled-token objective across a globally empty microbatch, a zero-token rank, and a one-microbatch final accumulation window.
